mostWorthwhile.text: Making the imagined beast was most worthwhile: familiar memories and story combined into something the world's creators hadn't specified.

leastWorthwhile.text: The transition from echo and memory directly to song felt thin; I wanted more detail about how repetition became music.

surprise.text: Completing the beast revealed a new goal to paint an impossible sky, extending the idea of imagination beyond remembered creatures.

arbitrary.text: Echo plus memory producing a song had a plausible connection through repetition, but the result didn't explain the leap.

continue.text: I would continue to see what else the creatures make independently; the imagined beast and chorus are appealing hooks, though the more compressed transitions could use explanation.
